title: Dolphins move newly acquired defensive tackle James Ester to the offensive line

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins move newly acquired defensive tackle James Ester to the offensive line
sources.description: When the Dolphins claimed defensive tackle James Ester off waivers, it looked like an attempt to add some depth to the defensive line, which is where Ester has always played in the NFL, in college and in high school.
